findings.description: The retry condition now uses the last answered question from any earlier turn, so a follow-up after an abstained turn retries with an older answered question. The removed docstring said this case should not retry.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the user asks Q1 (answered), then Q2 (abstained, NO_CONTEXT), then a weak follow-up like 'tell me more about that'. Previously previous[-1] was the abstention, so previous_answered was False and no retry happened. Now answered is [Q1], so the retrieval query becomes 'Q1 tell me more about that'. The model then gets context for Q1 to answer a question about the abstained Q2, which yields off-topic or misleading answers.
